title: Server pre-bundle scrubber generated at build time
evidence: scrubServerEvent and its helpers live in packages/health-core/src/sentry-scrub-server.ts; instrument-scrub.mjs is generated from it by tools/generate-instrument-scrub.mjs (PR 1484, A2-6 step 2), and the hand copy is gone. The step-1 parity test, sentry-scrub-server-parity.test.ts, was retired 2026-11-26 (Brad): it compared the source with its own output.
